rationale: Network flow telemetry exhibits severe pathological inversion (ROC-AUC=0.0919, score separation=-0.3178). The Isolation Forest isolates high-variance normal traffic as anomalous (mean A=0.3883) while assigning ultra-low anomaly scores to dense scanning probe bursts (mean A=0.0705). Without IP/port identity leakage, point-level Isolation Forest completely fails on network flows.
